coverageLimits: All 327 packed background records execute load_battle_bg independently; this does not rerun every configured two-layer natural encounter or full special Giygas render path.

Every packed PSI effect plays both 2bpp and 4bpp through show_psi_animation and actual BW_PSI_ANIM steps with prepared real enemy sprite data; this does not prove every ability-to-animation routing or natural battle action.

Decoded source bytes, uploaded graphics and palettes, every played arrangement/palette frame, bounded OAM count, protected VRAM and timer/cleanup state are asserted; no full visual parity or heard audio claim.
Repacked HAL backwards-copy at position zero uses the documented native clamp; original ROM streams are independently decoded without that adaptation.
Original animation 20 retains ten source-backed packed tail frames unused by its configured playback length; unused Redux background graphics slots retain explicit empty streams.
reproduction: Use battle_art_decode_qa_dev20.py with each owner-provided ROM/pack and matching immutable --build/--runtime. --redux selects pinned Redux tables. Each --scratch must be new.
Use battle_art_cold_qa_dev20.py with --old-assets, --new-assets and --compiled-rom plus the same immutable native build/runtime. No owner saves are used.
Archived red QA tools and old converter revisions retain their exact recorded SHA. Run archived tools with tools on PYTHONPATH and an explicit --native-source; their default ROOT is archive-relative.

Final pack is built locally with build_maternalbound_pack.py from the source ROM, pinned compiled Redux ROM, bridge and converted dialogue inputs. No ROM, pack, decoded graphics, palette bytes or saves appear in these public reports.
